name: review-agent-pi
description: pi 内核 ReviewAgent 生产仓：E-only 检视运行时与 reviewagent 产品包（研究对照线冻结在 demo/config-matrix，ADR-0014）

scripts.build:pi: pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-telemetry run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/chord run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-ai run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-agent-core run build
scripts.demo:http-server: pnpm --filter review-pi build && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.demo-http-server.json && node .tmp-gen/scripts/demo-http-server.js
